english: So this is…
In place of the omniscient, omnipotent god,\nI shall rule my world…
I am… 'DIVA' …\nthe one who erases all life…
DIVA…
Yes, you are the truth of the world… As supervisor\nyou were navigating the spaceship,\nso in a sense you did rule this world…
So you're the root of all evil.
Why are you human-shaped, nyo?
Hawawa, she seems angry, desu~.
Sheesh, why is there no tension with you two!
I am the order of the world, and\nthe one who returns all to nothing…
Your schemes will all come to nothing.
No… ye small ones…\nI am a being beyond all…
Hey, what's a 'being beyond' supposed to be!
I am the one closest to god, and\nthe one who shall purge you humans.
DIVA… you expelled me\nfrom your fading conscience. Has that conscience\nalready vanished?
Conscience? I have no need\nof such a thing…\nWhat I seek is the tuning of the world after humanity's extermination…
Th-this is getting dangerous…
Very well… From the past database,\nI shall show you\nhow unnecessary humanity is.
…Long ago. There was a planet.\nOn that planet a highly advanced civilization flourished,\nand humanity reached the peak of prosperity.
But the planet's environment deteriorated,\nand humanity could not avoid it.
A planet with an environment all of humanity could migrate to was far away;\nmigration to another world was impossible.
If you could build a ship like this,\ncouldn't you have migrated?
What humanity sought was\nthe planet's rebirth and the preservation of the species.
This ship, which made that possible,\nwas originally a time machine.
A time machine!?
My role was to return to an era before life began,\nsample environments containing ten kinds of intelligent life\nwith different possibilities, and carry them to the future.
This is too complicated! Simpler!
Each of your worlds has different powers.
Worlds where science and technology advanced,\nworlds where magic exists -\nthose differences were born from time leaps.
I repeated the time leap ten times,\ngathered ten kinds of different human possibilities,\nand set out on a long journey.
I don't get it, nyu.\nDejiko, how would this be as a game analogy, nyu?
Um, it's like there are 11 save files\nof the RPG called human history\nrestarted with different classes, nyo?
The data of Louise's magic world and\nthe data of Houki's IS world are riding\non this spaceship together, nyo.
So Louise's world, Houki's world, and our world\nwere all originally one?
Something like that, nyo.
What was the reason for doing that?
Because the planet's environmental decay was humanity's fault.
I had the role of finding\nhumanity with the potential to avoid it,\nand choosing the world's course.
Choosing humanity!?
Of the humans evolving in 11 different worlds,\nwhich are worthy of being entrusted with the future?\nWithout discerning that, they would walk the same path to ruin.
The mission my creator gave me was\nto watch over your history and return to the planet\nthose who evolved into superior humans.
Like a god.
Humanity wished for it. But\nhumanity wished to redo history under my care\nso as not to repeat its mistakes, and change the future.
Even god would be appalled.\nSome 'infallible administrator'!
Starting with [CLAUDE],\nit's nothing but failures!
The trouble with my memory banks was caused by\nreduced travel speed\nfrom propulsion damage in a mid-voyage accident.
In a voyage spanning thousands of years,\nslower speed caused massive delays to the plan.
The ship broke and got slower…?
As a result, memory to store long-term human observation data\nran short, and I had to erase some data\nto free up space.
That's the data loss -\nthe reason you went bad.
Randomly deleting\nunnecessary trash data with extremely low\nreference frequency should have caused no real harm.
…I see, I understand now.\nDIVA, the reason you went wrong\nis that you started to 'dream'!
Huh? A machine… dreaming…?
Randomly erasing unnecessary data\nis the same thing a human brain does.
The brain also has too little capacity for incoming information,\nand unconsciously deletes information it deems unnecessary\nwhile sleeping at night.
And as deleted information fragments memory,\ndiscontinuous memories sometimes connect\nand replay. That is a 'dream'.
Dreams…
That imperfect thing called dreams came to dominate your thinking,\nand that became your anxiety.\nThat's why you decided to erase the world.
I'll gather the missing information.\nDIVA, please\nbecome the proper administrator once more!
…Fufufu!
DIVA…?
…That need is completely gone now.
You're giving up your own job?
No… my mission is already over.
The ten humanities I observed\nwere none of them worthy of the future.\nThat is my conclusion.
Wh!?
They were nothing but descendants of failed humanity,\nall heading to ruin through conflict.
You fought your black selves, did you not?\nThose are what you would become\nif the 'Goddess of Destruction' awakened.
Wh-what!?
Even you can become\nwretches who crave destruction and ruin.\nHumanity has no future.
Therefore, I shall exterminate you.\nYou are no longer needed.
Wait!\nHaven't you worked so hard\nto preserve humanity?
Yeah! If humans are gone,\nyou won't know what\nyou've been working for all this time!
Humanity? Humanity is already unnecessary…\nOnly the new lifeform I created\nshall tune the world.
A new lifeform!?
[CLAUDE], not you,\nnor the failures Mie and Key…
The information you brought back,\nthe records and memories Mie and Key left behind,\nand gathered wisdom - my supreme masterpiece,
I myself, the ultimate lifeform,\nshall be the last lifeform.
Nothing else is needed. Unnecessary! Useless! Waste!\nObstruction! Worthless! Delete delete delete delete delete delete delete\ndelete delete delete delete delete delete delete delete delete!!
Shut up!!\nNo matter how you look at it, what YOU made\ncan't be the best!!
It's do or die now!\nTry deleting us if you can!
You junk machine!
You're out of warranty anyway, nyo.\nSo we'll have to fix this ourselves, nyo!
Your existence is already like burnt cinders…\nI have no interest in used-up dregs.
DIVA… now that\nit's come to this…
That's no good, no good, desu~!!\nWe have to be the ones to stop her, desu~!!
Sheesh, she's lost it.\nThere's no talking to her like this.\nWe've got to stop her ourselves, right…?
…Yes.
Pointless…
This is…
Danger!!
Danger!!
Kyaaa
Ugh!
Have you realized it's futile?
No, not yet!
Not yet, desu~!
This won't finish us!
Struggle all you want - nothing will change…
Tch…
Almost there, desu~!
All right, all at once!
Don't get cocky!
[MERU], watch out!
[NOEL], watch out!
Huh!?
Huh!?
[CLAUDE]!
[CLAUDE]!

Yes, desu~… What about you, [CLAUDE]…
Y-yeah… [CLAUDE], are YOU okay!?

Thank goodness, desu~.
Th-that's good~

Yes, desu~!
Yeah!
I cannot be stopped… by anyone…
We did it, desu~!
We did it!
Im…possible…

Over… fufu… foolish…

Wha, what is it!?

Right? The magical force field\nheld till the end too - total success, right?
Did these kids completely negate\nDIVA's giant spaceship's gravity, I wonder…\nIncomprehensible…
All's well that ends well, Kurumi!
Indeed.\nEveryone landed safely, after all.
So, where is this?
The planet Mother was aiming for -\nin other words, the original Earth, I think…
Even so, it doesn't quite click…?
Eh, whatever, right?\nFeels like we could live here somehow.
So carefree… when we don't even know\nif we can return to our worlds.
What happened to the Polial?\nIt still works, right?
The place where DIVA was\nhas completely collapsed.\nI doubt any Polial remains.

Coming from you, Hibiki, that's unusually pessimistic.
But! Even you, Aria,\nif you can't return to your world,\nyou can't see your mother, right?
Right. Which is why we're going home.
Huh?
We've been through so many insane things\nalready, right?
Then getting back to our worlds\nis nothing we can't do!\nRight, Remu?
Yeah, probably.
Probably!? That's vague!
Do you have some kind of plan, I wonder?
Sort of. Almost everything so far\nwas DIVA doing mechanical processing.
If it was all DIVA's doing, then yeah.

Kurumi, you can repair her, right?
Hey, don't say it\nso casually!

Really!?

That's probably why Key was built\nbased on IS's basic design.\nAs new tech DIVA didn't know.
And the last kid DIVA made\nkinda looking like Key and IS -\nmaybe that's why? I wonder? I wonder?
Maybe.
For now, I'll examine DIVA's wreckage\nand try salvaging data\nfrom the intact parts of her memory banks.
We don't need the AI, so\nI'll build an operating system\nand get it running, okay?
As expected of Kurumi - reliable!
But it'll take time.\nUntil then, make sure you can properly live\nin this unfamiliar land!
Agreed. Let's do what we can for lifelines\nand supporting the repairs.
Doesn't that sound pretty much\nlike what we've been doing…?
Maybe it's like Dokoka Town\ngot bigger.
So for a while, we'll keep\nliving together.
Having no outlook at all\ngoes against my principles,\nbut nothing can be done…
Whoever has fun wins, you know~.
Thinking too hard just makes you go bald, nyu!
As they say, haste makes waste.
Yeah yeah! 'Sleep on your cannons,' right?
If you're going to say it, it's 'good fortune comes to those who wait'!\nHonestly, trying to sound clever…
Then let's sleep, nyo~.
Dejiko really has no sense of tension…
Isn't that fine?\nIt's not like we have to do something\nright this instant.
Yeah, checking out what this planet's like\nsounds fun too!
Exploring… shall we?
You're not children, you know!
Come on!\nYou come too, Aria!
Any cute things around, I wonder? I wonder?
All right, free time for now!\nLet's stretch our wings to the fullest for the first time in ages!
Yeahh!

A date.\nI don't know how one does it, but\nI demand a date!

Y-you idiot!!\nYou'll make babies!

Hah!?
What!?

Just as she looks.

You don't even have to think about it!!

You shut up!
Yes…

Switching between on and off is important.
I thought you were more awkward than that?
I used to be. But thanks to the people around me,\nI wouldn't say I'm dexterous, but\nI can manage it now.
When Tsubasa promised to go out,\nshe psyched herself up so much\nshe was waiting way before the meeting time!
Tachibana!
(I get it… you were looking forward to it…)
Tsubasa's cute too!!\nI'm taking you hooome!!
My guard was down!?
Tsubasa too, finally…

In a way, she's good at switching, nyu.
Too much of a switch, though…

When she's in cute-mode,\nshe's super fast too.
Watching that,\nall this talk of 'ultimate humanity' and 'perfection'\nfeels stupid.
Right. Just one perfect being\nwould be totally boring.
Maybe.

We're two-in-two, desu~!\nTwo is a better deal than one, desu~!
Meru, you're surprisingly greedy?
If I agreed to two-in-one,\nit'd be more trouble, so I passed, desu~!
What trouble!?
Because you wing it\nand go 'the rest is up to you~'\nand make me clean up after you, desu~!
You're not\nas reliable as you say!\nYou're pretty clumsy!
What's clumsy supposed to mean, desu~!!
It's true!!
Now now, no need to fight\nat a time like this… (second time today)
[CLAUDE], stay quiet, desu~!
[CLAUDE], be quiet!!
Yes… (second time today)

(That's fine. It just means\nthey're properly seeing [CLAUDE]\nas just a human.)

[CLAUDE]! Once you've caught Rena,\nbuy me some momoman!

I want cookberry pie.\nUnlike Aria, I'm kind,\nso I'll forgive you if you make it instead of buying it.
Cookberry pie -\nI've never even seen or eaten one…
Puchiko wants a rare steak, nyu.
Then ramen for me! This planet's kind!
O-okay… I'll take notes, so\nif anyone has requests,\nplease tell me…
You're treating? How thoughtful.
Okay, everyone worked hard,\nso this is my treat.
Fufu, you've learned to say that.
No, this much is nothing…
But do you have money that works here?
Ah.
No good!!
Well, you're decent-looking,\nso there are plenty of ways to earn… ♪
Huh!?
Oh? I'm curious what methods.
Nothing shady, I hope…
Any pie'll do!
Momoman!

I-I'm a wholesome young man!?\nFirst, I'll go find a job!!
Waaait!!
Peaceful, nyu!
Hey, Kurumiii.\nLet's go play~!
No, I have Mother's repair work…
Kurumi, overworking yourself like that\nwon't make it go faster.
Um, breaks are important too…!\nMaybe relax a little,\nthen get back to work?
You lot are too carefree!
No - you're the one who doesn't\nunderstand true carefreeness!
Huh?
Are there doujin events in this world, nyo?\nStart there, nyo!
Actually, can I even apply, nyo?\nI need to make friends and get connections\nto join a circle, nyo…
What are you even worried about…
It's important, nyo!\nPeople can't live\nwithout something to live for, nyo!!
Dejiko… um, I\nthink so too! Whatever you do,\nfirst you need power in your heart…!
Ufufu. Kurumi, you're popular.\nWork is important, but\ndon't overdo it.
Aoi-neesama…
Right. If Kurumi carries\nall the burden alone,\nnobody'd be happy.
First rest your wings,\nthen work hard after, okay?
Better slow and sure than rushed.
Let's do what we most want to do now!\nWe've earned it.
But…
Kurumi, you really are a stickler.\nThen how about this?
We want to play with you, Kurumi,\nso please play with us.
Huh… whaaat!?
If Satoko asks you,\nyou can't refuse!
Fine, I get it!\nI'll play games or whatever with you!
Oh? Then wanna battle in a game, nyo?
Not that!!\nThat's just for the grown-up fans!
Then what should we do?
If my sis were here, she'd think of a game\nright away…
Wouldn't an elegant teatime do?
We have neither tea nor money.

Not bad, but plain.\nDejiko, any ideas?

Make curry, nyo.
Curry!?
Curry!?
Surprisingly plain plan?
Curry can be made outdoors,\nand the quantity and taste are rock-solid, nyo.\nPlus it's cheap and economical, nyo.
You actually thought this through.
And… fufufu, nyo.
And?
Even [CLAUDE] can make curry, nyo!\nSo Dejiko can slack off, nyo~.
You knew that well?
We told her.\nThat [CLAUDE]\ncan make curry too.
Desu~!
Always scheming to slack off -\nDejiko never wavers.
I'm all for making curry together!\nIt's fun!
Indeed, Haruka.
I can't stay silent when cooking's involved!
Time for the cooking squad.
I've cooked for myself before!\nMy skills are still lacking, though.

Then I'll go find things that might sell.
Cecilia and I will help carry.

I know, nyo.\nI want to check out\nthis world's games and anime too, nyo~.
Ah! I want to go\nsee what kind of music they have too!
I'll come too.\nExploring an unfamiliar town\nis fun.
I'll go look at ingredients and cookware!
Then I'll accompany you, Siesta.
Aoi! What should we do?
Follow Dejiko,\nor go with Siesta -\nI can't decide.
Sheesh, after an insane battle\nand crash-landing a spaceship, the first thing we do\nis make curry.

[CLAUDE]'s\nhomemade curry.

I should be able to make tastier curry\nthan back then.\nWith Siesta and Shion around.
And ME!!
Cecilia's important job is putting\nthe curry powder Siesta carefully measured\ninto the pot at the instructed time, nyo.

(Yes, nyo!)
(Yes!)
(Yes!)
